news.signals module

Signals for the news app.

When an article is approved: 1. Email subscribers of the journalist/publisher 2. POST to our own RESTful API endpoint (/api/approved/)

news.signals.get_article_subscribers(article)[source]

Collect all unique users subscribed to either the article’s publisher or author.

news.signals.handle_article_approval(sender, instance, created, **kwargs)[source]

Execute post-approval workflow: email subscribers, API POST, and logging.

news.signals.post_to_api(article)[source]

Simulate sharing an approved article by POSTing it to an internal API endpoint.

news.signals.send_approval_emails(article, subscribers)[source]

Send personalized HTML email notifications to a list of subscribers.

news.signals.track_approval_status(sender, instance, **kwargs)[source]

Determine if an article’s status is changing from unapproved to approved.

news.tests module

Unit tests for the news application.

Tests cover: - API authentication per role - Reader can only retrieve subscribed content - Journalist can create articles - Editor can approve and delete - Newsletter functionality - Signal logic with mocking

news.views module

View handlers for the News application, managing articles, publishers, and newsletters.

news.views.article_approve(request, article_id)[source]

Handle the approval of an article; restricted to editors.

news.views.article_create(request)[source]

Handle the creation of new articles; restricted to users with the journalist role.

news.views.article_delete(request, article_id)[source]

Handle article deletion; restricted to the original author or an editor.

news.views.article_detail(request, article_id)[source]

Render the detailed view of an article; restricts unapproved content to authors/editors.

news.views.article_edit(request, article_id)[source]

Handle the editing of articles; restricted to the original author or an editor.

news.views.article_list(request)[source]

Render a searchable list of approved articles, optionally filtered by publisher.

news.views.editor_dashboard(request)[source]

Render a dashboard for editors to manage pending and published articles.

news.views.home(request)[source]

Render the home page featuring the latest approved articles and active publishers.

news.views.journalist_detail(request, journalist_id)[source]

Render the profile and approved articles of a specific journalist.

news.views.journalist_list(request)[source]

Render a list of all active journalists.

news.views.newsletter_create(request)[source]

Handle the creation of newsletters; restricted to journalists and editors.

news.views.newsletter_detail(request, newsletter_id)[source]

Render the detailed content of a specific newsletter.

news.views.newsletter_list(request)[source]

Render a list of the most recent newsletters.

news.views.publisher_detail(request, publisher_id)[source]

Render the details and approved articles for a specific publisher.

news.views.publisher_list(request)[source]

Render a list of all active publishers.

Handle subscription and unsubscription logic for a journalist.
